headlines.title: 香港证监会：对耀才证券作出谴责并处以罚款280万港元
headlines.summary: 香港证监会对耀才证券国际（香港）有限公司（耀才）作出谴责并处以罚款280万港元，原因是该公司没有实施充足而有效的内部监控程序，以监察和侦测由其客户进行的清洗交易。香港证监会的调查发现，于2023年11月1日至2025年9月13日期间，由于耀才的内部监控措施不足，导致615个客户帐户执行了1,021对涉及736只股票及权证的清洗交易。香港证监会亦发现，由于耀才在2024年3月前主要依赖交易后监察及人手审查来识别可疑交易活动，客户因而得以在被侦测前进行清洗交易。（香港证监会网站）

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong SFC reprimands Bright Smart Securities, fines HK$2.8 million
headlines.summary_en: The Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) has reprimanded and fined Bright Smart Securities International (Hong Kong) Limited (Bright Smart) HK$2.8 million for failing to implement adequate and effective internal control procedures to monitor and detect wash trades conducted by its clients. The SFC's investigation found that from November 1, 2023, to September 13, 2025, Bright Smart's insufficient internal controls allowed 615 client accounts to execute 1,021 wash trade pairs involving 736 stocks and warrants. The SFC also found that because Bright Smart relied primarily on post-trade monitoring and manual review to identify suspicious trading activities before March 2024, clients were able to conduct wash trades before detection. (SFC website)

headlines.title: 商务部新闻发言人就美发布“强迫劳动”301调查最终措施答记者问
headlines.summary: 商务部新闻发言人就美发布“强迫劳动”301调查最终措施答记者问。 问：美东时间7月23日，美国贸易代表办公室依据“未禁止进口强迫劳动产品”301调查结果，发布最终措施，对包括中国在内的60个经济体加征301关税，对华加征12.5%的301关税。请问中方对此有何回应？ 答：我们注意到有关情况。中方一贯反对强迫劳动，建立了完善的劳动法律法规体系，坚决防范和打击强迫劳动行为。反观美方，不仅仍未批准加入《1930年强迫劳动公约》，还长期操弄“强迫劳动”议题，此次又以“强迫劳动”为由发起301调查并加征单边关税，是典型的单边主义、保护主义行为，中方对此坚决反对。

headlines.title_en: MOFCOM spokesperson responds to US final measures on 'forced labor' Section 301 investigation
headlines.summary_en: Ministry of Commerce spokesperson responds to U.S. release of 'forced labor' Section 301 investigation final measures. Q: On July 23 Eastern Time, based on the results of the 'Imports Not Banned for Forced Labor Products' Section 301 investigation, the U.S. Trade Representative released final measures, imposing Section 301 tariffs on 60 economies including China, with an additional 12.5% Section 301 tariff on China. What is China's response? A: We have noted the situation. China has always opposed forced labor, established a comprehensive labor law system, and resolutely prevents and combats forced labor. In contrast, the U.S. has not only failed to ratify the 1930 Forced Labour Convention but has also long manipulated the 'forced labor' issue. Launching a Section 301 investigation and imposing unilateral tariffs based on 'forced labor' is typical unilateralism and protectionism, which China firmly opposes.

headlines.title: 美宣称拟对中国人工智能企业开展调查并实施制裁 商务部回应
headlines.summary: 问：近日，美国一些高级官员公开表示将针对中国人工智能企业所谓“蒸馏”美前沿模型开展调查，并可能以“窃取美国知识产权”等为由制裁中国企业。请问中方对此有何评论？ 答：我们注意到有关情况。中方一贯反对美方将科技经贸问题政治化、工具化，以各种莫须有的理由污名化中国企业并实施制裁。美方罔顾有关中国企业人工智能模型与美前沿模型发布时间非常接近、中国部分模型能力已处于领先地位等事实，给中国企业扣上所谓依靠“蒸馏”“窃取美国知识产权”等帽子，还威胁进行打压制裁。这些做法缺乏事实依据，没有法理支撑，在实践上搞双重标准，属于典型的人工智能霸权主义行径。

headlines.title_en: US claims to investigate and sanction Chinese AI firms; MOFCOM responds
headlines.summary_en: Q: Recently, some senior U.S. officials publicly stated they will investigate Chinese AI companies for alleged 'distillation' of U.S. frontier models and may sanction Chinese companies under claims of 'stealing U.S. intellectual property.' What is China's comment? A: We have noted the situation. China consistently opposes the U.S. politicizing and weaponizing technological and economic issues, stigmatizing Chinese companies with unfounded pretexts and imposing sanctions. The U.S. ignores facts that relevant Chinese AI models were released very close in time to U.S. frontier models, and some Chinese models are already leading, instead falsely accusing Chinese companies of relying on 'distillation' and 'stealing U.S. intellectual property,' while threatening suppression and sanctions. These actions lack factual basis and legal support, apply double standards in practice, and represent typical AI hegemonism.

headlines.summary: 金十数据7月27日讯，商务部新闻发言人表示，中方敦促美方倾听中美两国业界客观、理性声音，纠正霸权思维，停止对中国企业的抹黑和制裁威胁。对于任何实质性损害中方利益的行为，中方将采取一切必要措施，坚定维护自身正当合法权益。希望美方切实落实两国元首共识，同中方相向而行，加强人工智能对话、沟通，共同推动人工智能向上向善，通过推进并完善人工智能治理造福两国和世界。

headlines.title_en: MOFCOM spokesperson responds to US claims to investigate and sanction Chinese AI firms
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 data July 27 - Ministry of Commerce spokesperson stated China urges the U.S. to listen to the objective and rational voices of industries from both countries, correct hegemonic thinking, and stop smearing and threatening sanctions against Chinese companies. For any actions that substantially damage China's interests, China will take all necessary measures to firmly safeguard its legitimate rights and interests. China hopes the U.S. will effectively implement the consensus of the two heads of state, work with China in the same direction, strengthen AI dialogue and communication, jointly promote AI for good, and advance and improve AI governance for the benefit of both nations and the world.

headlines.title: 商务部：据了解，很多美国人工智能企业在研发和训练中蒸馏了中国的模型
headlines.summary: 金十数据7月27日讯，商务部新闻发言人表示，创新不是任何一方的专利。中国人工智能企业长期深耕基础研究，坚持科技自立自强与开放合作并重，秉持共商、共建、共享理念，推动人工智能技术快速发展，在前端代码能力等越来越多的领域取得喜人成就。据了解，很多美国人工智能企业在研发和训练中蒸馏了中国的模型。值得注意的是，美业界众多企业公开反对美国威胁制裁中国人工智能企业。近200家美国初创企业敦促美国政府不要切断对中国开源模型的访问，认为这将削弱美国企业竞争力。一些美国大型跨国企业表示，模型蒸馏是一种行业广泛应用的技术，应允许美国企业使用中国开源人工智能模型。

headlines.title_en: MOFCOM: Many US AI firms have distilled Chinese models in R&D and training
headlines.summary_en: Jin10 data July 27 - Ministry of Commerce spokesperson said innovation is not a patent of any party. Chinese AI companies have long been deeply engaged in basic research, adhering to both technological self-reliance and openness, upholding the principle of extensive consultation, joint contribution, and shared benefits, promoting rapid AI development, and achieving gratifying results in more and more fields such as front-end code capabilities. It is understood that many U.S. AI companies have distilled Chinese models during R&D and training. Notably, many U.S. industry companies publicly oppose U.S. threats to sanction Chinese AI companies. Nearly 200 U.S. startups urged the U.S. government not to cut off access to Chinese open-source models, arguing that would weaken U.S. corporate competitiveness. Some large U.S. multinationals stated that model distillation is a widely used industry technology, and U.S. companies should be allowed to use Chinese open-source AI models.

The U.S. ignores facts that relevant Chinese AI models were released very close in time to U.S. frontier models, and some Chinese models are already leading, instead falsely accusing Chinese companies of relying on 'distillation' and 'stealing U.S. intellectual property,' while threatening suppression and sanctions. These actions lack factual basis and legal support, apply double standards in practice, and represent typical AI hegemonism.

headlines.title_en: Disease Prevention and Control '15th Five-Year' Plan: Promote inclusion of vaccines with heavy disease burden, high cost-effectiveness, fiscal affordability, and international consensus into national immunization program
headlines.summary_en: With approval from the State Council, the National Health Commission, National Disease Control and Prevention Administration, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, General Administration of Customs, and National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine jointly issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Disease Prevention and Control.' The plan proposes dynamically optimizing the types of vaccines in the National Immunization Program, promoting the inclusion of vaccines with high disease burden, good cost-effectiveness, fiscal affordability, and international consensus. For key populations such as middle-aged and elderly people and women, it promotes vaccination against diseases with high burden and good efficacy, gradually achieving full-lifecycle immunization and vaccination for all people. It also pushes for secondary and above medical institutions to provide vaccination services, fully promoting electronic vaccination certificates and cross-regional data sharing to provide fairer, more accessible, and convenient vaccination services.

headlines.title_en: Disease Prevention and Control '15th Five-Year' Plan: By 2030, basically establish a modern disease control system with Chinese characteristics
headlines.summary_en: With approval from the State Council, the National Health Commission, National Disease Control and Prevention Administration, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, General Administration of Customs, and National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine jointly issued the '15th Five-Year Plan for Disease Prevention and Control.' The plan proposes that by 2030, a modernized disease control system with Chinese characteristics will be basically established, the institutional system and working mechanism for preventing and defusing large-scale epidemic risks will be more complete, a multi-point trigger, sensitive infectious disease monitoring and early warning system will operate efficiently, capabilities for scientific assessment, precise prevention and control, emergency response, medical treatment, and material support will be significantly improved, public health scientific research and talent team building will achieve new breakthroughs, preparedness for emerging and sudden infectious disease outbreaks will be more adequate, epidemic risks of key infectious diseases will be effectively controlled, and harm from major diseases will be effectively curbed.

headlines.title: 万亿巨头工业富联，盘后利好
headlines.summary: 问：近日，美国一些高级官员公开表示将针对中国人工智能企业所谓“蒸馏”美前沿模型开展调查，并可能以“窃取美国知识产权”等为由制裁中国企业。请问中方对此有何评论？ 答：我们注意到有关情况。中方一贯反对美方将科技经贸问题政治化、工具化，以各种莫须有的理由污名化中国企业并实施制裁。美方罔顾有关中国企业人工智能模型与美前沿模型发布时间非常接近、中国部分模型能力已处于领先地位等事实，给中国企业扣上所谓依靠“蒸馏”“窃取美国知识产权”等帽子，还威胁进行打压制裁。这些做法缺乏事实依据，没有法理支撑，在实践上搞双重标准，属于典型的人工智能霸权主义行径。

headlines.summary_en: China Association for Public Companies released its June statistical monthly report. Data shows that as of June 30, 2026, there were 5,535 listed companies in the domestic stock market, with 2,314 on the Shanghai Stock Exchange, 2,898 on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, and 323 on the Beijing Stock Exchange. By share type, there were 5,263 companies issuing only A-shares, 265 companies with multi-share types such as A+H or A+B, and 7 companies issuing only B-shares.
